title: Structure theorem of finitely generated abelian groups
statement: Let G be a finitely generated additive commutative group. There exist n : ℕ, an index type ι : Type with Fintype ι, functions p,e : ι → ℕ with Nat.Prime (p i) for every i, and an additive group isomorphism G ≃+ (Fin n →₀ ℤ) × ⨁ i : ι, ZMod (p i ^ e i). No positivity assumption on e is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the existing Mathlib theorem AddCommGroup.equiv_free_prod_directSum_zmod to G with its AddCommGroup and AddGroup.FG instances. Its existential witnesses and additive equivalence are exactly the conclusion, including Fintype ι and Nat.Prime (p i). This is a direct Mathlib leaf, not a new Lean proof obligation.
